newsitem.title: USA: Furniture files for up to 13.8 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Furniture files for up to 13.8 mln shares.

text.p: Furniture Brands International Inc said Friday its shareholders are offering up to 13.8 million common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the shareholders said they are offering 9.6 million shares in the United States and 2.4 million in the international market.

The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option for up to 1.8 million shares. The offering will be made through Smith Barney, CS First Boston, Dillon, Read & Co Inc, Merrill Lynch & Co and Wheat First Butcher Singer.
After the offering, the company will have 61,426,281 common shares outstanding. The shareholders will receive the proceeds from the sale.
Apollo Investment Fund L.P. and Lion Advisors L.P. on behalf of an investment account, which are the selling shareholders, own about 55.1 percent of the outstanding, the filing said.
Of the total shares, one-half are being offered by Apollo and one-half are being offered by Lion, the filing said.
The St. Louis, Mo.-based company manufacturers retail furniture including Broyhill and Lane.
